translation.套餐购买已经从钱包中拆分出来，页面会单独展示月卡、日卡和右侧状态面板。: Plan purchases have their own page, with monthly and daily plans and a status panel on the right.
translation.比较月卡和日卡的额度、周期和适用场景。: Compare monthly and daily plans by quota, duration, and intended use.
translation.按需选择目标套餐，进入购买前确认。: Select a plan and review it before purchasing.
translation.套餐页单独展示月卡与日卡，不再混入钱包。: Monthly and daily plans appear on the Plans page rather than in the wallet.
translation.点击订阅后会先进入购买前确认弹窗。: Selecting Subscribe opens a confirmation dialog before purchase.
translation.选择前先确认周期、总额度和适用场景，再进入订阅确认弹窗。: Check the duration, total quota, and intended use before confirming a subscription.
translation.盲盒页会单独展示购买入口、奖励规则、结果弹窗和开奖记录。: The Blind Box page shows purchase options, reward rules, draw results, and history.
translation.从左侧进入盲盒页面。: Open Blind Box from the sidebar.
translation.查看可抽奖励、中奖规则和当前状态。: Review the available rewards, draw rules, and current status.
translation.选择购买数量后完成支付，结果会在弹窗中展示。: Choose a quantity and pay. The result appears in a dialog.
translation.统一额度直接进入账户: Universal quota is added directly to your account
translation.结果弹窗确认后完成入账: Confirm the result to complete the credit
translation.盲盒页集中展示规则、概率和活动状态。: The Blind Box page shows rules, odds, and activity status together.
translation.购买前先确认当前价格、数量和支付方式。: Check the current price, quantity, and payment method before buying.
translation.抽到统一额度后，会直接进入账户并永久有效。: Universal quota won in a draw is added to your account and does not expire.
translation.结果弹窗可以直接关闭，也可以点击确定确认领取。: Close the result dialog or select Confirm to acknowledge the reward.
translation.钱包页现在只负责余额、兑换码、账单和扣费优先顺序设置，右侧栏继续保留策略配置。: The Wallet page handles balance, redemption codes, billing, and payment priority. Strategy settings remain in the right panel.
translation.进入钱包页查看余额和账单状态。: Open Wallet to check your balance and billing status.
translation.在右侧栏设置订阅优先或余额兜底等扣费策略。: Set billing priority in the right panel, such as using plan quota first or wallet balance as a fallback.
translation.通过兑换码入口补充额度或完成后续资金操作。: Use a redemption code to add quota, or continue with other wallet actions.
translation.钱包页保留资金与扣费策略管理，不再承载套餐与盲盒入口。: The Wallet page manages funds and billing order; plans and blind boxes have separate pages.
translation.钱包页重点查看余额信息、兑换码入口和扣费优先顺序。: Check your balance, redemption codes, and billing priority in Wallet.
translation.设置完成后，系统会按保存后的扣费策略执行额度消耗。: After saving, quota is deducted according to your selected billing order.
translation.Code Go 是一个围绕 AI 编程工作流构建的平台，帮助你把使用过程持续积累: Code Go is a platform for AI coding workflows that helps you build on your work over time.
translation.Code Go 的核心理念是什么？: What is Code Go's core idea?
translation.让 AI 编程的每一步，都算数。: Make every step of AI coding count.
translation.适合长期使用 Codex、Claude Code 和多模型工作流的开发者与团队。: Developers and teams who use Codex, Claude Code, or multiple models regularly.
translation.Code Go 支持哪些使用场景？: What can I use Code Go for?
translation.包括 API 调用、套餐订阅、额度管理、脚本下载、成就记录和持续使用记录。: API calls, plan subscriptions, quota management, script downloads, achievements, and usage history.
translation.因为 AI 编程不只是一次性完成任务，更重要的是持续使用和持续进步。: AI coding is more than completing one task; regular use and continued progress matter too.
translation.Code Go 和普通 AI API 平台有什么区别？: How is Code Go different from a typical AI API platform?
translation.它除了接入和计费，也会把使用过程、记录和进度一起保留下来。: Alongside access and billing, Code Go keeps your usage history and progress together.
translation.说明文档最前面先保留售后支持入口。遇到配置、套餐、盲盒、宠物升级或脚本使用问题时: The guide starts with a support contact. For setup, plans, blind boxes, pet upgrades, or scripts, scan the code to join the QQ support group.
translation.优先使用手机 QQ 扫描下方二维码加入售后群。: Use QQ on your phone to scan the QR code below and join the support group.
translation.如果当前设备不方便扫码，也可以直接在 QQ 中搜索群号 996040309。: If you cannot scan the code, search for group 996040309 in QQ.
translation.进群后建议附上账号、页面位置和问题截图，方便快速定位。: When asking for help, include your account, the page involved, and a screenshot of the issue.
translation.售后 QQ 群号：996040309。扫码或手动搜索群号都可以进入。: QQ support group: 996040309. Scan the code or search for the group number.
translation.建议把报错页面、控制台提示或具体操作步骤一并发群，沟通会更快。: Share the error page, console message, or steps to reproduce the issue for faster support.
translation.主页会集中展示 Code Go 的定位、模型入口和桌面端下载路径，帮助新用户快速: The home page shows what Code Go offers, where to find models, and how to download the desktop app.
translation.先从首页了解站点定位、主要功能入口和模型广场。: Start on the home page to review the platform, main features, and model marketplace.
translation.根据当前目标选择配置密钥、查看模型或下载桌面端，再进入对应流程。: Choose the next step for your goal: set up an API key, browse models, or download the desktop app.
translation.首页首屏展示产品定位、核心入口与当前模型概览。: The first screen introduces the platform, key entry points, and available models.
translation.新用户先完成注册，再进入控制台配置自己的开发环境。: New users should register before setting up their development environment in the console.
translation.打开注册页，填写用户名、邮箱和密码。: Open the sign-up page and enter a username, email address, and password.
translation.提交后即可完成注册，并进入后续登录流程。: Submit the form to create your account, then sign in.
translation.注册页用于创建新的 Code Go 账号。: Use the sign-up page to create a Code Go account.
translation.注册完成后使用账号密码登录，即可进入用户控制台。: After registering, sign in with your account credentials to open the console.
translation.输入用户名或邮箱与密码。: Enter your username or email address and password.
translation.登录成功后会进入控制台概览页或系统指定页面。: After signing in, you will reach the console overview or the page selected by the system.
translation.登录页支持使用账号密码进入站点。: Use your account credentials to sign in on this page.
translation.概览页会展示当前资金状态和常用功能，适合作为日常使用的起点。: The overview shows your balance and frequently used features, making it a useful starting point.
translation.登录后先查看概览页，确认余额、套餐和盲盒入口。: After signing in, review your balance and the links to plans and blind boxes.
translation.左侧侧边栏已经将套餐购买和盲盒活动单独拆分出来，钱包只保留资金与扣费策略。: The sidebar separates plan purchases and blind box activities. The wallet focuses on funds and billing order.
translation.控制台概览用于统一查看日常入口与当前状态。: Use the console overview to see common actions and your current status.
translation.进入 API 密钥页面，创建用于脚本和客户端接入的访问密钥。: Open the API Keys page to create a key for scripts and client applications.
translation.打开 API 密钥页面，点击创建。: Open the API Keys page and select Create.
translation.填写名称并选择分组后保存。: Enter a name, select a group, and save.
translation.创建成功后在列表中确认新密钥已经出现。: Confirm that the new key appears in the list.
translation.通过抽屉表单创建新的 API Key。: Create a new API key in the side panel.
translation.保存后可在列表中看到新创建的密钥。: After saving, the new key appears in the list.
translation.在 API Key 列表的操作菜单中可以直接下载 Codex 配置脚本，用于快速: Download a Codex setup script from an API key's actions menu to configure Codex locally.
translation.在目标 Key 的操作菜单中打开 Codex 配置脚本选项。: Open the Codex setup script option in the selected key's actions menu.
translation.按操作系统下载对应脚本。: Download the script for your operating system.
translation.Windows 脚本双击运行后会自动配置好 Codex，并保留窗口显示成功提示，: On Windows, double-click the script. It configures Codex, displays a success message, and waits for a keypress before closing.
translation.Linux 脚本执行完成后会直接输出 Codex 配置成功提示。: On Linux, the script prints a success message when Codex setup is complete.
translation.支持从 Key 列表直接下载 Codex 配置脚本。: Download the Codex setup script directly from the key list.
translation.脚本内容会基于当前 API Key 自动生成。: The script is generated for the current API key.
translation.下载后不需要再手动拼接 Codex 认证信息。: You do not need to assemble Codex credentials manually after downloading it.

translation.The system compares the last four digits: The system compares the last four digits of your membership card number with the single four-digit lucky number announced for the whole site that day, one digit at a time from right to left. More consecutive matches earn a higher base reward, and the membership tier multiplier is then applied.
translation.The prefix CG-7K2M9Q identifies the card: The prefix CG-7K2M9Q identifies the card and does not participate in matching; only the final four digits are used for the daily draw. Leading zeros are part of the suffix and must be kept.
translation.Result: the final 2 digits \"16\" match: Result: the final 2 digits "16" match consecutively
translation.The rightmost 6 equals 6 and the second: The rightmost 6 equals 6 and the second digit from the right, 1, equals 1. The third digit, 3, does not equal 8, so the comparison stops there: this is not a 3-digit match, and other matching digits on the left do not count.

translation.One draw is held every day at {{time}} (: One draw is held every day at {{time}} ({{timezone}}). The system publishes one four-digit lucky number for the whole site, from 0000 to 9999.
translation.A subscription participates automaticall: A subscription participates automatically when it is active at the draw snapshot, belongs to a monthly plan, has Daily Lucky Number enabled, and already has a membership card number.
translation.A membership card purchased, renewed, or: A membership card purchased, renewed, or upgraded before the draw uses the status and tier captured at that draw. Changes completed after the draw take effect from the next draw.
translation.Each active membership card owned by the: Each active membership card owned by the same user is matched independently. Rewards are credited to the specific card that produced the match.
translation.No check-in, manual sign-up, or extra dr: No check-in, manual sign-up, or extra draw purchase is required. Purchasing, renewing, or upgrading a membership card currently does not grant a blind box automatically; blind boxes and Daily Lucky Number are separate benefits.
translation.Take the final four digits from the comp: Take the final four digits from the complete membership card number.
translation.Compare it with the single four-digit lu: Compare it with the single four-digit lucky number announced for the whole site that day.
translation.Only consecutive matches starting at the: Only consecutive matches starting at the rightmost digit count.
translation.A 2-digit match does not also add the 1-: A 2-digit match does not also add the 1-digit reward.
translation.Important: do not count every digit that: Important: do not count every digit that appears somewhere in both strings. Only the uninterrupted suffix match from the rightmost digit is counted.
translation.The first digit from the right is alread: The first digit from the right is already different.
translation.Only the rightmost 1 digit matches conse: Only the rightmost 1 digit matches consecutively.
translation.The base reward plus an equal share of t: The base reward plus an equal share of the jackpot.
translation.The order is: determine the number of co: The order is: determine the number of consecutive matching digits, then apply the membership tier multiplier. Only the highest match is paid once; the jackpot share for a full four-digit match is not multiplied.
translation.After settlement, the reward is added au: After settlement, the reward is added automatically to the matched membership card balance, not the ordinary wallet. If the page shows "crediting", the original draw will continue to settle and will not generate a new number.
translation.The jackpot starts at {{initial}}. If no: The jackpot starts at {{initial}}. If no card matches all four digits, it increases by {{increment}}, up to {{cap}}; when there is a full match, all full-match cards split it equally and the next draw resets it.
translation.Rewards cannot be withdrawn, traded, or: Rewards cannot be withdrawn, traded, or transferred, and cannot purchase extra draw entries. The card number and winning records remain available, but an expired card does not join new draws.
translation.The whole site receives one four-digit l: The whole site receives one four-digit lucky number per day. Different cards may hold the same suffix; leading zeros are preserved, and the published draw record is the source of truth.
translation.Active membership cards automatically jo: Active membership cards automatically join one site-wide draw each day. Card numbers are permanent, and winning rewards go directly to the matched card balance.

translation.legal.userAgreementMarkdown:
# Code Go User Agreement

Welcome to Code Go. Our aim is to make every step of AI coding count. Please read this agreement before using the service so that account activity, quota use, progress, and model access remain reliable.

## Service

Code Go provides accounts, model access, quota billing, subscriptions, promotional activities, and developer tools. You must use the service lawfully and follow platform rules.

## Account and security

- You are responsible for your account, API keys, redemption codes, and signed-in devices.
- Do not share, resell, or abuse accounts or profit from system vulnerabilities.
- If you notice unusual sign-ins, unauthorized charges, or leaked keys, change or disable the affected credentials promptly.

## Acceptable use

- Do not use the platform for unlawful activity, infringement, attacks, bypassing access controls, automated abuse, fraud, or harm to the public interest.
- Do not use scripts, APIs, or automation to maliciously consume resources, evade safeguards, or disrupt billing.
- Models, plans, blind boxes, points, and activities may have separate rules shown on their respective pages.

## Quota, plans, and activities

- Wallet balance, plan quota, blind box rewards, redemption codes, and points follow the rules displayed by the platform at the time.
- Plans, subscriptions, blind boxes, pets, and progress features may change with operating policies.
- Code Go may adjust quota, discounts, activities, and access when prices, upstream models, payment providers, or risk policies change.

## Interruptions and changes

Maintenance, upgrades, upstream provider issues, network failures, or compliance requirements may interrupt some services. Code Go will try to maintain continuity but does not promise that every model or feature will always be available.

## Compliance and responsibility

You are responsible for assessing model output and the consequences of its use. Users bear losses arising from violations of law, platform rules, or third-party rights.

## Agreement updates

Code Go may update this agreement for product, operating, compliance, or security reasons. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated agreement.
translation.legal.privacyPolicyMarkdown:
# Code Go Privacy Policy

Code Go supports AI coding workflows. We aim to retain only the information needed for accounts, billing, safeguards, and service reliability.

## Information we collect

- Account information: username, email, sign-in method, and necessary identity verification details.
- Usage records: request time, model, quota use, errors, and basic device and IP security information.
- Payment and order information: top-ups, plans, redemption codes, points, blind boxes, and subscriptions.
- Preferences and settings: language, theme, billing order, common settings, and authorization status.

## Why we collect it

- To provide sign-in, plan purchases, quota billing, and API access.
- To prevent abuse, enforce safeguards, and investigate service quality issues.
- To show your progress, achievements, and cumulative activity.

## What we do not do

- We do not publicly display the content of your private requests.
- We do not sell your account information to third parties.
- We do not retain sensitive data long term without a business need.

## Retention and security

- We retain logs, billing, and risk records only as needed for the business.
- We use access controls, encryption in transit, and least-privilege access to protect data.
- Additional retention required for compliance, payments, or security follows applicable law.

## Third-party services

Code Go may use third-party model providers, payment services, notification services, or security verification services. They may process necessary data under their own policies.

## Your rights

You may contact the site operator to request access to, correction of, or deletion of some account information. Billing, risk, or compliance records may not be deleted immediately.

## Contact

For privacy matters, account data requests, or complaints, contact Code Go through in-site notices, the support group, or the contact details published on the site.

translation.本时段暂无消费日志样本，无法拆分 Token。: No consumption log samples are available for this period, so the token breakdown is unavailable.
translation.最近日志未提供 Token 明细。: Recent logs do not contain token details.
translation.本时段最近 {{count}} 条消费日志（共 {{total}} 条）；与上方: The latest {{count}} consumption logs in this period ({{total}} total); this sample differs from the hourly token totals above.
translation.输入兑换码或卡密: Enter a redemption code or card key
translation.新额度包永久有效、无周期重置，按钱包同价扣费；仅适用于已接入的渠道。: New credit packs never expire or reset periodically. They use wallet pricing and are available only on participating channels.
translation.到账额度已包含赠额，具体金额以当前套餐和支付确认页为准。每次购买生成独立额度包，: Total credited quota includes the bonus. Amounts follow the current plan and payment confirmation. Each purchase creates a separate credit pack without extending or resetting existing entitlements.
translation.官方渠道默认接入；市场渠道由渠道主选择是否接入。额度包与通用钱包独立记账，按钱包: Official channels participate by default; marketplace channel owners choose whether to opt in. Credit packs and wallet funds are tracked separately and used in the funding order set in your wallet.
translation.旧套餐已停止新售，已购权益保留原有效期、倍率与扣费规则。历史刷新权益仅适用于符合: Legacy plans are no longer sold. Purchased entitlements retain their original validity, multipliers, and billing rules. Historical quota resets apply only to eligible legacy plans.
translation.套餐增额分担怎么算: How plan bonus costs are shared
translation.本次结算毛额 × 套餐赠额 ÷ 套餐到账总额。渠道承担该成本的 60%，官方承担: Gross settlement amount × plan bonus credits ÷ total credited by the plan. The channel covers 60% of this cost and the platform covers 40%.
translation.结算毛额 − 5% 平台佣金 − 渠道承担的增额成本。符合邀请返利条件的新套餐消: Gross settlement − 5% platform commission − the channel’s share of the bonus cost. For new-plan usage eligible for referral rebates, a further 3% of paid usage is deducted from that channel’s pending net revenue.
translation.套餐实付额度 100 credits、赠额 10 credits，到账共 110: A plan provides 100 paid credits plus 10 bonus credits, totaling 110 credits. For 11 credits of usage: platform commission is 0.55, bonus cost is 1, the channel’s share is 0.60 and the platform’s share is 0.40, leaving net channel revenue of 9.85 credits. If the first-week referral rebate also applies, another 0.30 is deducted, leaving 9.55 credits.
translation.增额 5% / 6% / 7% / 8% / 10%，佣金与增额分担合计约为毛额: For bonuses of 5% / 6% / 7% / 8% / 10%, commission plus bonus cost sharing totals approximately 7.86% / 8.40% / 8.93% / 9.44% / 10.45% of the gross amount. Referral rebates are additional. Each transaction is rounded to the nearest minimum billing unit.
translation.市场渠道默认关闭新套餐接入，开启后参与对应套餐结算。旧套餐转余额的集享增额由平台: Market channels disable new-plan access by default. Enabling it includes the channel in settlement for those plans. The platform funds group bonuses on legacy-plan wallet conversions; this usage settles at wallet rates without new-plan bonus cost sharing.
translation.受邀人通过你的邀请链接或邀请码完成注册，并成功绑定邀请关系。: The invitee must register through your referral link or code and successfully establish the referral relationship.
translation.从受邀人注册时刻起连续 7 天（168 小时），按消费结算时间判定；满 7 天后: The period lasts 7 consecutive days (168 hours) from the invitee’s registration, determined by usage settlement time. Usage settled after that period is excluded.
translation.返利 = 首周已结算的合资格实付消费 × {{rate}}。充值、购买套餐和转账: Rebate = eligible paid usage settled during the first week × {{rate}}. Top-ups, plan purchases and transfers do not generate rebates on their own.
translation.钱包现金充值及现金购买的新套餐，仅按已消费额度中的实付部分计算。赠送额度、返利余: For cash wallet top-ups and cash-purchased new plans, only the paid portion of consumed credits qualifies. Bonus credits, usage funded by rebates, legacy plans, wallet balances converted from legacy plans and their group bonuses, and historical converted plans without a successful payment record are excluded.
translation.消费结算完成后自动处理，返利计入邀请人的可用钱包，无需领取。处理完成前，返利明细: Rebates are processed automatically after usage settlement and credited to the referrer’s available wallet balance; no claim is required. Rebate details may update after processing completes.
translation.按每位受邀人的累计合资格消费，以最小计费单位计算返利；尾差随该受邀人后续合资格消: Rebates are calculated in minimum billing units from each invitee’s cumulative eligible usage. Rounding remainders carry forward with that invitee’s subsequent eligible usage.
translation.仅计算规则生效后的消费，历史消费不补发。邀请活动已停止新增旧套餐刷新次数。: Only usage after the rules take effect qualifies; past usage is not credited retroactively. Referrals no longer grant additional refreshes for legacy plans.
translation.转换规则与 299 套餐示例: Conversion rules and the 299 plan example
translation.基础余额 = 折算基数 × 转换额度占旧套餐总额度的比例；集享增额 = 基础余额: Base balance = conversion basis × converted quota as a share of the legacy plan’s total quota; group bonus = base balance × the applicable group bonus rate; wallet credit = base balance + group bonus. Converting all remaining quota uses remaining quota ÷ total quota, independent of remaining days. Amounts are rounded down to minimum billing units.
translation.单笔付款采用实付金额；多笔续费或升级补差采用该旧套餐方案价格，按剩余额度占总额度: A single payment uses its paid amount. Multiple renewals or upgrade payments use the legacy plan price, multiplied by remaining quota divided by total quota. Gifted plans without payment orders use the plan price. Amounts convert numerically into credits without currency exchange; the preview shows the basis.
translation.折算基数为 299：未参与集享且全部未使用，可转 299 credits；剩余: With a conversion basis of 299 and no group bonus: a fully unused plan converts to 299 credits; 50% remaining converts to 149.5 credits. A fully unused plan with a 3% group bonus credits 307.97 credits; with a 5% bonus, 313.95 credits.
translation.基础金额与集享增额分别记账，一同计入可用钱包，按钱包价格消费。转换同步扣减旧套餐: The base amount and group bonus are recorded separately and credited together to your available wallet, with usage charged at wallet rates. Conversion deducts legacy quota at the same time. Full conversion ends the plan; partial conversion preserves its original expiry. Converted funds and group bonuses are not new cash payments and do not generate referral rebates or cash refunds. This action cannot be undone; historical conversions retain their original entitlements.
translation.关于 CodeGo | 模型、路由与公司信息: About CodeGo | Models, routing and company information
translation.CodeGo 提供多模型 API 接入、路由市场和统一用量管理，由 CodeGo: CodeGo offers multi-model API access, a routing marketplace and unified usage management, operated by CodeGo AI Limited. Explore platform features, company registration and official communities.
translation.CodeGo,CodeGo AI Limited,模型 API,路由市场,公司信: CodeGo,CodeGo AI Limited,model API,routing marketplace,company information
translation.CodeGo 汇集模型 API，连接 Codex、Claude Code 与兼容: CodeGo brings model APIs together for Codex, Claude Code and compatible tools. The model catalog shows available models, prices and connection details.
translation.用户可以选择市场渠道、建立路由池，并查看渠道状态与使用记录。渠道主通过独立工作台: Users can choose market channels, create routing pools and review channel status and usage records. Channel owners manage their channels, pricing and revenue in a dedicated workspace.
translation.控制台集中管理 API 密钥、钱包、套餐和调用日志。消费、套餐余额与邀请返利分别: The console centralizes API keys, wallet, plans and request logs. Usage, plan balances and referral rebates are tracked separately, with rules and details on their respective pages.
translation.每 1 次可用刷新次数可兑换 1 份当前最低档套餐，成功后扣除 1 次；剩余次数: Each available refresh credit can be redeemed for one current lowest-tier plan. One refresh credit is deducted on success; remaining credits can be redeemed again. The redeemed plan has permanent credits charged at wallet rates. Redemption is a gift from legacy entitlements, not a cash payment, and generates no referral rebate or cash refund.
translation.扣除 1 次刷新机会，兑换 {{plan}}，获得 {{amount}} 永久套: Use 1 refresh credit to redeem {{plan}} with {{amount}} in permanent plan credits. {{count}} refresh credits will remain after success. This action cannot be undone.
translation.按该旧套餐所属集享计划的有效付费参与人数计算已达成档位：3 至 4 人增额 3%: Use the achieved tier based on valid paid participants in the legacy plan’s group: 3–4 participants receive a 3% bonus, 5 or more receive 5%, and fewer than 3 receive no bonus. Placeholder members and members without a successful payment are excluded. The conversion preview determines the actual rate.
translation.旧套餐有效期内已使用邀请刷新的，当前不支持转换。未使用的刷新次数可在“刷新次数兑: Conversion is currently unavailable if a referral refresh was used during the legacy plan’s active period. Unused refresh credits can be redeemed for the lowest-tier plan under ‘Redeem refresh credits for plans’, independently of converting a legacy plan to wallet balance. The confirmation dialog and server validation determine the amount actually eligible for conversion.
translation.将 {{plan}} 的 {{percent}}% 转入钱包：基础 {{base: Convert {{percent}}% of {{plan}} to your wallet: base {{base}}, group bonus {{bonus}}, total {{credit}}. Deduct {{quota}} from the legacy plan, leaving {{remaining}}%. {{ending}} This action cannot be undone.
translation.套餐增额率 = 套餐赠额 ÷ 套餐实付额度；附加手续费率 = 套餐增额率 × 6: Plan bonus rate = bonus credits ÷ paid credits; surcharge rate = plan bonus rate × 60%; total fee rate = 5% + surcharge rate.
translation.渠道净收益 = 结算毛额 − 5% 基础佣金 − 套餐增额分担费 − 邀请返利。: Channel net income = settlement gross − 5% base commission − plan bonus surcharge − referral rebate. Bonus surcharge = settlement gross × plan bonus rate × 60%; referral rebates use eligible paid usage.
A 3% plan bonus gives a 3% × 60% = 1.8% surcharge and a 6.8% total fee. For a settlement gross of 100 credits: base commission 5, bonus surcharge 1.8, and no referral rebate result in 93.2 credits of channel net income.
translation.增额 5% / 6% / 7% / 8% / 10%，综合手续费率分别为 8%: Bonuses of 5% / 6% / 7% / 8% / 10% give total fee rates of 8% / 8.6% / 9.2% / 9.8% / 11%. Referral rebates are separate. Each charge is rounded to the smallest billing unit; historical logs retain their original settlement snapshots.
translation.官方渠道默认支持套餐；市场渠道由渠道主开启新套餐接入。旧套餐转余额的集享增额由平: Official channels support plans by default; marketplace channel owners enable new-plan access. The platform funds group bonuses from legacy plan-to-wallet conversions; these settle as wallet usage without the new-plan bonus surcharge.
translation.净收益 = 毛额 − 基础佣金 − 增额分担 − 邀请返利: Net income = gross − base commission − bonus surcharge − referral rebate
translation.刷新旧套餐与兑换新套餐共用可用次数，每次操作成功扣除 1 次。旧套餐刷新每月最多: Legacy plan refreshes and new plan redemptions share the same available uses. Each successful action consumes 1 use. A legacy plan can be refreshed once per month, retaining its expiry and billing multiplier. Converted legacy plans cannot be refreshed. Fuel and additional top-up credits are not restored.
translation.扣除 1 次刷新机会，刷新 {{plan}}（#{{id}}），恢复 {{amo: Use 1 refresh to refresh {{plan}} (#{{id}}) and restore {{amount}} credits. Its expiry and billing multiplier remain unchanged. This action cannot be undone.
translation.旧套餐已停止新售，已购权益保留原有效期、倍率与扣费规则。可用刷新次数可用于符合条: Legacy plans are no longer sold. Purchased entitlements retain their original expiry, multipliers and billing rules. Available refresh credits can refresh eligible legacy plans (at most once per month), or each can be redeemed for one current lowest-tier new plan. Both actions share the same refresh balance and deduct one credit on success.
translation.新套餐按实付比例转余额: Convert new plans at the paid ratio
translation.选择当前剩余额度的 1%–100% 转换。到账余额 = 本次扣除额度 × 购买时: Convert 1%–100% of your current remaining quota. Wallet credit = quota deducted × original paid quota ÷ original granted quota. Promotional quota is excluded. Amounts are rounded down to the smallest billing unit.
translation.部分转换后剩余额度继续可用；全部转换后该套餐结束。余额按钱包价格消费，不产生新增: Partial conversion keeps the remaining quota usable; full conversion ends this plan. Converted funds use wallet prices and earn no new top-up referral rewards. Conversion cannot be undone and is unavailable with refund records or unsettled requests.
translation.当前没有可转换的套餐。: No plans are currently eligible for conversion.
translation.将 {{plan}} 当前剩余额度的 {{percent}}% 转为余额：扣除套: Convert {{percent}}% of the current remaining quota in {{plan}}: deduct {{quota}} plan quota, receive {{credit}} in your wallet, and keep {{remaining}} plan quota. {{ending}} This action cannot be undone.
translation.全部转换后该套餐结束。: This plan ends after full conversion.
translation.剩余套餐额度继续可用。: The remaining plan quota stays usable.
translation.选择套餐和转换比例，预览到账余额后再确认。: Select a plan and percentage, then review the wallet credit before confirming.
